name: f7-s611
prompt: <image1> shows a creature. Draw the same creature at its next, more grown-up stage. The whole silhouette changes: it rises into the air: the fin-wings grow into two pairs of wide, soft, rounded coral wings spread to both sides; the long body hangs upright below the wings and the tail hangs down in one gentle wave. Keep the face, the coral cheeks, the three soft coral gill fronds on each side of the head, the cream belly stripe from chin to tail tip and the flat style without outlines; the body is light warm apricot (#FFC56E), not orange. Fins and wings are coral, never turquoise or green. No teeth, no claws. Full body, plain flat pale mint background.
